subject: nereid-v8-hourglass
q: Nereid v8's bust gate would re-measure almost the whole family.
detail: Thirty-two girls carry measurements. Against the proposed bands, THIRTY of them already land in one — the ranges are well calibrated to what is already written, which is the good news. Against the BUST GATE, only THREE pass: Akane (0.952), Yvaine (0.974) and Ceri (1.000). Every other measured girl has a bust more than five per cent narrower than her hips, Bella most severely at 0.783. Adopting v8 therefore means adjusting twenty-nine busts upward, which is a Nereid rewrite on the scale of an arc rather than a bookkeeping pass — and arguably a lovely one to write. Two girls also sit below every band on ratio alone: Bella at 0.565 and Abbi at 0.591. And Siren is the only odd waist in the canon at 25 inches; the even-number rule rounds her down to 24, which moves her from Pronounced to Extreme. That is the rounding bias working exactly as designed, on a real girl.
